jobs.prompt: Create a premium anatomical exercise illustration for BARBELL FRONT RAISE, catalog0041, ADULT MALE. Reference provides artistic style and forward shoulder raise only; REPLACE dumbbells with ONE straight barbell with matching small plates/collars at both ends. Two equal side-by-side panels with generous white gutter, same model camera scale bar clothing. Near side-front three-quarter camera so forward arm direction obvious while both hands and entire bar are visible. Stand feet shoulder-width, knees relaxed, torso upright. Left panel arms down in front of thighs, hold bar using overhand grip shoulder width, palms toward thighs. Right panel arms raised FORWARD to shoulder height, elbows nearly straight but softly unlocked, bar horizontal in front at shoulder height, palms down, wrists neutral, no curling or lateral raise or overhead position. Keep torso vertical without leaning back, feet unchanged. Real hands wrap shaft and thumbs closed, equipment continuous through hands, unchanged plates each panel. Red ANTERIOR DELTOID on front shoulder caps only, no red biceps or chest. Detailed grayscale anatomical exposed limbs with realistic proportions, crisp HD white background and soft shadows. Black sleeveless opaque top covering torso chest sides back and knee-length black shorts completely enclosing rear seat crotch sides/front/back, seams folds closed leg openings, shoes. No transparency, cutaways or missing cloth. Whole bar/body inside each panel with margins. No text captions numbers labels arrows logos.
jobs.inspectionNote: Visual and qualified anatomical review pending.
